mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread reporting King main thrust bearings out of spec on the free-spread dimension, with a 2024 main and a 2025 main both measured bad, pointing at a manufacturing-process problem rather than a one-off. Reads as the most serious item on the panel.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread telling builders to measure every King bearing before installing. Title alone is an explicit warning to other buyers on a busy BMW forum.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch again failed with connection refused (ECONNREFUSED) on the e90post host; thread could not be read.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX thrust bearings reported over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, with the poster advising against King mains for those engines and saying that getting something this fundamental wrong means the bearings cannot be trusted.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content, same as the previous check.

mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Long-running engine-builder thread on King quality; includes a report of a 2024 King main out of spec on free spread and a 2025 main also measuring bad. Mixed thread with positive reports alongside the criticism.
mentions.replyNote: Thread is readable and still open; no official King representative has responded and it is not locked or marked resolved.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Complaint about an unopened King package containing the wrong bearing assortment, including mismatched halves, combined with a complaint about the customer-service response to the claim.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: King Bearings Quality?
mentions.snippet: Mopar forum thread questioning King bearing quality. A King representative has posted an official clarification in the thread; it remains open.
mentions.replyNote: A user identifying as kingbearings posted an official clarification in August 2026 opening with "A little late to the thread, but we wanted to add some clarification for anyone who finds this in the future"; thread remains open and unresolved.
